Resume Worded / finance-intern resume keyword guidance 2026

asset_management: strong interest in finance and asset management
fund_distribution_ir: constructing a narrative around investment strategies
evidence_recruiters_reward: quantified results in dollars and percentages
hands-on exposure to financial tools and real data (even academic projects)
relevant coursework and specialisation named explicitly

recruiter_fears_to_preempt: 'Will code, not analyze markets' — AI projects must read as finance leverage, not software engineering
Self-invented titles that don't map to any job req
Unverifiable claims (personal 'fund' with no track record framed as investing skill)
Breadth without depth — 20 projects can read as unfocused
